LibTmux.Query.Session

Description

Session fields and contextual children for LibTmux.Query.

All tokens describe the tmux 3.3a baseline. windowLinks preserves each observed index, including several links to one physical window. clients describes captured attachments and may be a known empty relationship.

id :: Field Session SessionId Source #

Native session ID without a connection-generation guarantee.

name :: Field Session Text Source #

Captured UTF-8 session name. Equality does not normalize Unicode.

attached :: Field Session Integer Source #

Nonnegative count of attached clients as observed by tmux.

windowLinks :: ToMany Session WindowLink Source #

Every window link owned by this session, retaining index and multiplicity.

clients :: ToMany Session Client Source #

Captured clients attached to this session; an empty list is known absence.
